footnote: Source: CPCA monthly reports, Jul–Aug 2025 and 2026. Passenger car home retail, changes are the two years' published figures subtracted
notes: Home retail in July and August fell by 819k units. NEVs accounted for 132k of that and conventional fuel cars, hybrids without a plug included, for 687k. In August alone conventional cars sold 540k, down 40%, with pure petrol cars down 45%. So NEV share passed 65% because fuel cars collapsed faster, not because NEVs sold more. NEV retail itself was down 10.1% in August and 20% in September 1–27.
